name: ⛏️ Mining World
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Mining World ⛏️

Mine rocks, upgrade your pickaxe, and uncover valuable finds!

❤️ Like the game for updates & exclusive codes!

[How To Play]
▪ Equip your pickaxe!
▪ Click on rocks to mine them!
▪ Interact with machines to unlock new areas!
▪ Use your finds to buy better pickaxes and go even deeper!

Premium users receive 2x Mining Luck
